decided_by: PI decision: shift the confirmation block to a verifiably unused seed range before running anything

prospective_not_retrospective.no_confirmation_episode_was_ever_run: block 2500001 was never spent; the m1_payoff/searcher/screen paths all used other blocks
prospective_not_retrospective.no_SDS_G1_4_confirmation_result_existed: when this amendment was made there was no outcome to react to
prospective_not_retrospective.candidate_already_frozen_first: SDS_G1_4 was frozen in CANDIDATE_A_SDS_G1_4_FROZEN.json BEFORE this seed question was raised
prospective_not_retrospective.why_this_is_not_moving_goalposts: the change restores compliance with a seed-hygiene rule that predates the candidate, is independently auditable, and cannot have been influenced by any result because no result exists

what_was_discovered.collision: seed 2500001 was previously used to TRAIN artifacts/g0_v2_seed2500001 (G0-V2, 1,000,000 timesteps, run_tag g0_v2_seed2500001)

second_candidate_also_rejected.collision: seeds 2600001, 2600002, 2600003 trained the G0-V2 penalty-ablation arms (artifacts/g0_v2_penalty_ablation/g0_v2_nopen_seed260000{1,2,3}/, checkpoints present)
second_candidate_also_rejected.note: rejected as a whole block. Individual clean seeds inside it were NOT cherry-picked, per the frozen instruction.

what_was_discovered.direct_leakage_assessment: NONE for this confirmation. GUARD/BREACH are scripted styles and the opponents are scripted; no learned policy participates, so no policy can have memorized these environment realizations.
what_was_discovered.why_amend_anyway: the campaign's pre-existing hygiene rule requires evaluation seeds disjoint from all training seeds. There is no benefit to weakening a stronger rule when compliance is free.
what_was_discovered.map_set_makes_the_rule_bite: the confirmation path runs map_set='train' (MAP_SET_SEED_OFFSETS['train']=0), so an evaluation seed equal to a training seed drives the map/env RNG to the identical state. Integer-level disjointness is therefore the correct check, not a merely cosmetic one.

amended_block.why_32: matches the frozen Gate B precedent in experiments/M1_PAYOFF_ASSAY_FROZEN.json (seed_block.n = 32), which produced 128 episode rows = 32 seeds x 2 opponents x 2 blue styles with the same seed paired across styles. Episode count is inherited, NOT newly chosen.

check_1_declared_seeds.definition: integers in a genuine seed context: JSON keys containing 'seed', CSV columns containing 'seed', filenames/dirnames tagged seed<N>, python assignments to names containing SEED

check_2_any_integer.definition: deliberately over-inclusive: ANY 6-12 digit integer in any tracked text file, including global_step, timesteps and CSV payload

check_3_declared_block_spans.definition: any declared (base, n) pair whose span base..base+n-1 overlaps the window, catching a block that reaches into the range from outside it

check_4_git_history.why: a working-tree scan cannot see seeds used by deleted artifacts. Phase 11 deleted 205 files. Block 11000000 (VGC-4) is exactly such a case: it appears in 5 historical commits but NOWHERE in the working tree.
check_4_git_history.result: 0 commits across all branches and all history
check_4_git_history.positive_control: the identical query shape against the known-dirty window 2600001..2600032 returned 3 commits (27c6a816, afc48a84, 0872c16f), proving the query detects hits and that the empty result for 5000001 is a true negative rather than a broken query

population_offset_margin.risk: rl/population/population_trainer.py assigns per-member seed_offset up to 300, so a declared training seed T can legitimately occupy T..T+300
population_offset_margin.handling: the audit required a clear margin of >5000 on both sides, far exceeding 300. The selected block clears the nearest declared seed by 820556 below and 3786206 above.

reproduce.self_reference_exclusion: the audit tool and the reservation records themselves are excluded from every check, because a record that RESERVES a block would otherwise make that block look permanently used. The exclusion list is echoed inside each audit record. The positive control (2600001, 3 commits) still fires with the exclusion active, proving it narrows self-reference without disabling detection.

permanently_disqualified.2500001: DISQUALIFIED for strategic-demand confirmation, permanently. Collides with training run g0_v2_seed2500001. Do not resurrect this block for confirmation under any later protocol.
permanently_disqualified.2600001: DISQUALIFIED for strategic-demand confirmation, permanently. Collides with the g0_v2 penalty-ablation training seeds 2600001-2600003.
permanently_disqualified.rule_going_forward: any future evaluation block must pass scripts/audit_seed_block.py over its FULL intended range, including the git-history check, before being frozen.

deliberately_not_edited.experiments/strategic_demand_searcher.py: V1's help text and console lines still say 'never touches 2500001'.
